package proto

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/metrics"
	"time"
)

// gcStopRun forces gcs GCs, 2 ms apart, while runWorkers keeps
// GOMAXPROCS-1 workers busy, then prints the stop-the-world histogram of the
// run: every nonzero bucket and P50, P99 and max (bucket upper bounds).
func gcStopRun(label string, gcs int, runWorkers func(n int, stop <-chan struct{}) func()) {
	n := runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0) - 1
	if n < 1 {
		n = 1
	}
	read := func() *metrics.Float64Histogram {
		s := []metrics.Sample{{Name: "/sched/pauses/stopping/gc:seconds"}}
		metrics.Read(s)
		return s[0].Value.Float64Histogram()
	}
	stop := make(chan struct{})
	wait := runWorkers(n, stop)
	time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
	before := read()
	for i := 0; i < gcs; i++ {
		runtime.GC()
		time.Sleep(2 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	after := read()
	close(stop)
	wait()
	var total uint64
	counts := make([]uint64, len(after.Counts))
	for i := range after.Counts {
		counts[i] = after.Counts[i] - before.Counts[i]
		total += counts[i]
	}
	fmt.Printf("%s: %d workers, %d stops\n", label, n, total)
	for i, c := range counts {
		if c > 0 {
			fmt.Printf("  [%.1f, %.1f) µs: %d\n", after.Buckets[i]*1e6, after.Buckets[i+1]*1e6, c)
		}
	}
	q := func(p float64) float64 {
		target := uint64(float64(total)*p + 0.999999)
		var cum uint64
		for i, c := range counts {
			cum += c
			if cum >= target && c > 0 {
				return after.Buckets[i+1] * 1e6
			}
		}
		return 0
	}
	fmt.Printf("  P50 <= %.1f µs, P99 <= %.1f µs, max <= %.1f µs\n", q(0.5), q(0.99), q(1))
}
